body: This looks okay to me. Really exciting improvement overall! Slight behavior changes are fine with me as well, but I'd like @nt1m to have the final call on those.
I don't think we should proceed with the behavior changes, based on the comments I've added.
A bunch of style changes to keep this spec's more archaic style, and also to match how the algorithms are invoked with how it's done in HTML.
Changes to adapt to https://github.com/w3c/csswg-drafts/commit/038516478f4cfb0b405291b67d845b77face09b5 and stick with `<var>` as the rest of the spec does.

This is all good now IMHO, much nicer with the dropped document argument to many algorithms.
